Tiago Ribeiro
Digital Marketing & Paid Media Specialist
Summary
Marketing specialist with 3 years of professional experience managing paid traffic
acquisition campaigns, conversion funnels, and performance analytics.
Professional Experience
Digital Marketing Specialist
Impulso Digital Agency (2021-Present)
Managing paid advertising campaigns on Meta Ads and Google Ads focusing on
B2B lead generation.
Performing on-page SEO optimization.
Building conversion funnel performance reports utilizing Google Analytics 4.
Education
B.Sc. in Communication Sciences and Marketing
University of Minho (2018-2021)
Core Competencies
Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), Search Engine Optimization (SEO),
Google Analytics 4, Copywriting, Email Marketing, Conversion Funnel
Optimization.
